title: Bound on a folded maximum
statement: Let $L$ be a finite list of natural numbers and let $B\in\mathbb{N}$. If every entry of $L$ is at most $B$, then folding the maximum operation over $L$, starting from $0$, gives a value at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite list of natural numbers
every entry of $L$ is at most $B$
replaced:
Let $L$ be a finite list of natural numbers and let $B$ be a natural number. If every
entry of $L$ is at most $B$, then the result of folding the maximum operation over $L$,
starting from $0$, is at most $B$.
